_comment: P3-B1 tweaked (opt-in, approved by Corleone 2026-10-06): identical to phase3_b1 (26 genes = controller 8 + FD structure_v2 12 + FD shape_b1 6, fidelity full_a1_b1, same decode / gate / init / mutation / evaluator) plus the preset 'ga' block, option names mirrored from Evolution Runner's batch config: (a) ga.shape_crossover 'uniform': per child, after parent selection, 8 draws = rng.random(8): controller, structure, then the 6 shape genes in gene order; draw < 0.5 -> parent A (ranked[i]); controller and structure stay whole blocks, each shape gene is inherited on its own; replaces the shape block's whole-block draw (default 'block' = rng.random(3) < 0.5, unchanged). Mutation unchanged, drawn after crossover. (b) ga.elite 4: the top 4 rows of the stable-argsort cost ranking copied unchanged before reproduction (no re-rank, no mutation); applied by run_evolve.py unless --elite is given on the CLI. Selection stays flat rank, p = 0.2. Shape genes: all 6 LINEAR in value (FD r1 GENE_ENCODING); 'log' is FD's spanwise chord interpolation, and genome's shape init / mutation work in ln x internally for the 3 chord tapers. See PHASE3_B1_SPEC.md section 9.
name: phase3_b1_x
